_comment: Reference benchmarks for validation mode (Phase 3.5). Values are from open, published sources (Glasstone & Dolan 'The Effects of Nuclear Weapons' 1977; Hiroshima/Nagasaki DS02 dosimetry; public Castle Bravo fallout reconstructions). 'tolerance_frac' is the acceptance band for the model-vs-reference check. Entries flagged 'approximate' are order-of-magnitude coverage targets, not precise anchors.

thermal.note: conservative: Phase 1 transmittance neglects forward scatter

fallout.case: Castle Bravo 15 Mt surface, lethal fallout downwind extent
fallout.metric: downwind extent of ~450 rem (48 h, unsheltered) contour
fallout.source: public Castle Bravo (1954) fallout reconstructions; strongly wind-dependent

fallout.case: 1 MT fission surface, 1000 R/hr H+1 downwind extent
fallout.metric: downwind extent of 1000 R/hr H+1 contour (idealized 15 kt wind)
fallout.source: Glasstone & Dolan idealized unit-time reference dose-rate pattern

crater.case: 1 Mt surface, dry soil apparent crater radius
